summary.text: Jay Bowman is an independent candidate for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District and a small-business owner who has lived in Kentucky since the mid-1990s. He campaigns on fiscal responsibility and a "10/10 Plan" to cut federal spending and reduce the deficit.

paragraphs.text: Bowman says he was born in Michigan and raised in Utah, where his father's small-business success inspired him and his mother's pursuit of education instilled a love of learning. According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Grayling, Michigan, graduated from Olympus High School and has worked as an entrepreneur.
He says he started his own business at 24, moved to Kentucky in the mid-1990s, and has raised his family there as a small-business owner. He is on the 2026 general election ballot as an independent.
